name: Exp_XKRI_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the XKRI_Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram rises and sell positions when it falls. It uses configurable money management, fixed stop-loss and take-profit, and provides separate toggles for opening and closing positions on both sides. Signal generation occurs on new bar formation with a one-bar signal delay by default.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XKRI_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，当直方图上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓。它使用可配置的资金管理方式、固定止损止盈，并分别提供多空两侧的开仓和平仓开关。信号默认在K线形成时生成，使用一根K线延迟。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于XKRI_Histogram指标的动量变化进行交易。入场条件为：当直方图值从前期下降转为上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当直方图值从前期上升转为下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定止损（默认1000点）和固定止盈（默认2000点），同时支持基于反向信号的平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认为0.1。指标本身结合了KRI周期、MA平滑方法、XMA平滑算法等多个参数，具有较强的可调性。信号生成仅在新K线形成时触发，避免了逐tick计算的冗余，但SignalBar设为0时会在每个tick都执行信号判断。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's core strategy trades on momentum changes detected by the XKRI_Histogram indicator. Entry conditions: a buy is opened when the histogram value rises from a prior decline (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell is opened when the histogram value falls from a prior rise (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (default 1000 points) and take-profit (default 2000 points), with optional signal-based position closing via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose toggles. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, net free margin percentage, net balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. The indicator itself combines KRI period, MA smoothing method, and XMA smoothing algorithm with multiple configurable parameters. Signal generation triggers only on new bar formation by default, avoiding redundant per-tick computation, though setting SignalBar=0 enables tick-level signal evaluation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/净自由保证金/净余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Position mode: fixed lot or margin percentage

parameters.name: BuyPosOpen
parameters.description: 是否允许在多头信号时开多仓

parameters.name: SellPosOpen
parameters.description: 是否允许在空头信号时开空仓

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许在反向信号时平多仓

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许在反向信号时平空仓

parameters.name: MA_Method_
parameters.description_en: MA smoothing method for KRI indicator

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 价格类型：收盘/开盘/最高/最低/中位/典型/加权等

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已闭合K线）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于动量方向变化进行交易，逻辑简洁明了
提供独立的多空开仓和平仓开关，灵活控制交易方向和出场方式
支持五种仓位管理模式，资金管理方式丰富且可配置
默认使用新K线触发信号，避免逐tick冗余计算，执行效率较高
止损止盈参数均可配置，默认止盈为止损的两倍，具备正期望收益特征
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on momentum direction changes, simple and straightforward
Independent buy/sell open and close toggles provide flexible control over trade direction and exit method
Five position sizing modes offer rich and configurable money management options
Default new-bar signal triggering avoids per-tick redundant computation, improving execution efficiency
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit with default TP at 2x SL ratio, exhibiting positive expectancy characteristics
cons: 止损默认1000点偏大，在波动剧烈市场中可能承受较大单笔亏损
缺乏移动止盈/追踪止损功能，可能错失浮动利润的锁定
未检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能产生重复开仓导致仓位叠加
无点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下入场成本可能过高
SignalBar=0时会在每个tick执行信号判断，与默认新K线逻辑不一致，容易产生误用
cons_en: Default 1000-point stop-loss is large, potentially incurring significant single-trade losses in volatile markets
No trailing stop or breakeven functionality, which may miss opportunities to lock in floating profits
No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially causing duplicate entries and position stacking
No spread filter mechanism, entry costs may be excessive in high-spread environments
SignalBar=0 triggers signal evaluation on every tick, inconsistent with the default new-bar logic and prone to misuse
improvements: 增加同方向持仓检查逻辑，避免重复开仓导致仓位过度叠加
添加移动止盈/追踪止损功能，以更好地保护浮动利润并优化出场策略
improvements_en: Add same-direction position check logic to prevent duplicate entries and excessive position stacking
Implement trailing stop or breakeven functionality to better protect floating profits and optimize exit strategy

risk_points: 默认止损1000点偏大，单笔亏损可能较大
无同方向持仓检查，可能重复开仓导致仓位叠加风险
无点差过滤，高点差环境下交易成本不可控
risk_points_en: Default 1000-point stop-loss is large, single-trade loss can be significant
No same-direction position check, risk of position stacking from duplicate entries
No spread filter, trading costs are uncontrolled in high-spread environments
